scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of four robed men kneeling on a rocky ledge, with a larger gathering behind them. Two foreground men bow their heads; two older men look toward a distant, cloud-touched mountain above a winding path. Cream, rust, ochre and blue cloth contrasts with sunlit stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The four foreground figures imaginatively represent Moses, Aaron, Nadab and Abihu; the receding gathering represents the seventy elders without a countable reconstruction. Kneeling figures and the open climb toward distant heights illustrate the command to come up and worship from afar. The scene anticipates that instruction; clothing and landscape are artistic conventions, and God is not depicted.
